description: This Java class defines the OfficeDomain object used in integration tests within the Fineract project. It provides data encapsulation for office properties, methods to serialize/deserialize to/from JSON, and a builder pattern for object creation.

classes.name: OfficeDomain
classes.description: Represents an office entity with properties like id, name, externalId, openingDate, and hierarchy. Includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and hash code.

classes.name: OfficeDomain.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for creating immutable instances of OfficeDomain with a fluent API.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the OfficeDomain instance into a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an OfficeDomain object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to initialize the Builder with required parameters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the office.

methods.name: getNameDecorated
methods.description: Returns the decorated name of the office.

methods.name: getExternalId
methods.description: Returns the external identifier of the office.
